lead_raw_text:
The structure of La2ZnGe adopts the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with a 16-atom unit cell containing four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Ge centers with 9 neighbors (1 Ge, 8 La) and La centers in two environments: 14 neighbors (4 Ge, 10 Zn) and 13 neighbors (6 Ge, 7 Zn), while Zn is 12-coordinate with a close-packed-like local arrangement. The periodic neighbor graph is fully connected in three dimensions. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing between Ge and La polyhedra, and corner and edge sharing between La polyhedra.
